title: Great houses rise in Chaco Canyon
summary: Ancestral Pueblo builders created great houses and connected sites in Chaco Canyon between approximately 850 and 1250. The buildings formed part of a wider regional landscape.

citations.note: Supports the factual summary and chronology. Context includes explicitly interpretive comparisons; the date note identifies limits of precision.

claims.text: Ancestral Pueblo builders created great houses and connected sites in Chaco Canyon between approximately 850 and 1250. The buildings formed part of a wider regional landscape.

Large settlements can be compared through construction and community organization. Chaco’s occupation sequence is not the lifespan of Pueblo peoples, whose histories continue beyond this archaeological phase.
